g.text: Dynamic view — durable acceptance, chain confirmation and proof export
Return a receipt only after transaction commit.
A receipt is not chain confirmation or a zero-loss recovery promise.
Revoked keys are rejected; duplicate submissions are idempotent.
Chain outages leave accepted events pending and retry.
No timeout promotes an event to CONFIRMED.
Database PITR and encrypted backups support ordinary service recovery.
Backup completion is not on the acceptance path; roots cannot restore missing payloads.
